title: Yellow Spicy Saudi Arabian Lamb Wrap
description: A pungent and springy Saudi Arabian dish featuring peach juice and ssam wrap, perfect for a date night, this keto friendly recipe is sure to impress
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
In a blender, combine peach juice, yellow curry powder, ghee, garlic, ginger, cayenne pepper, and salt, and blend until smooth
Place the lamb shoulder in a large bowl and brush the curry mixture all over it
Wrap the lamb in foil and roast in the oven for 20 minutes per pound
Remove the lamb from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes
Slice the lamb into thin strips
Warm the ssam wrap pieces by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20 seconds
Assemble the wrap by placing a few slices of lamb onto a piece of ssam wrap and serving immediately
